records.name: Vue UCheckbox
records.purpose: Native checkbox input with a decorative check or minus box, supporting binary mode, array-membership mode and an indeterminate state.
records.surface: UCheckbox (Options API SFC Checkbox.vue, name "UCheckbox") and createBaseCheckbox (BaseCheckbox.ts) plus checkboxStyleModule and CheckboxClassesParams (checkbox-style.ts; not re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseInput (vue-core base-input: size, fluid, variant props, resolvedVariant, resolvedFluid) over createBaseEditableHolder (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue); because createBaseInput takes no arguments, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. Declared props: value, binary, indeterminate, trueValue, falseValue, disabled, readonly, required, tabindex, inputId, inputClass, inputStyle, ariaLabelledby, ariaLabel, invalid, name (plus inherited size, fluid, variant, modelValue, defaultValue). Emits declared: change, focus, blur, update:indeterminate. Template: root div with one native input type="checkbox" (id, value, name, checked, tabindex, disabled, readonly, required, aria-labelledby, aria-label, aria-invalid set from invalid) and a decorative box div rendering UCheckIcon when checked or UMinusIcon when dIndeterminate; no slots. Only @change is bound on the input: onFocus and onBlur methods exist, but no template listener calls them, so focus and blur are declared in emits and never emitted. checked is false whenever dIndeterminate is true; otherwise binary mode compares dValue with trueValue and non-binary mode requires an array dValue that includes value. onChange returns before writing when disabled or readonly; binary mode writes trueValue when indeterminate or unchecked and falseValue when checked; array mode filters value out when checked or indeterminate and appends it otherwise; when dIndeterminate it then clears it and emits update:indeterminate false; then writeValue(newValue, event) and change with the native event. updateIndeterminate copies dIndeterminate to the native input.indeterminate in mounted, updated and the indeterminate watcher. styleParams passes checked, disabled, invalid, variant (resolvedVariant) and size, so the inherited size prop is read: the root renders u-checkbox with u-checkbox-checked, p-disabled, p-invalid, p-variant-filled (variant filled), u-checkbox-sm (size small) and u-checkbox-lg (size large). The css includes the style string imported from @ultimate/uix-styles/checkbox. A checkbox group is not ported (source comment). writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. Style module registered as checkbox. checkbox.api.mdx is generated documentation and is excluded.

records.name: Vue UToggleButton
records.purpose: Native button that toggles a boolean value and shows an on or off label and optional icon.
records.surface: UToggleButton (Options API SFC ToggleButton.vue, name "UToggleButton") and createBaseToggleButton (BaseToggleButton.ts) plus toggleButtonStyleModule and ToggleButtonClassesParams (toggle-button-style.ts; not re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseEditableHolder directly (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue), not createBaseInput, so there is no pcFluid injection or inherited variant prop; because the holder is created with its empty default style module, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. Declared props: onIcon, offIcon, onLabel ("Yes"), offLabel ("No"), readonly, tabindex, ariaLabelledby, ariaLabel, disabled, invalid, fluid (a plain own boolean prop) plus modelValue and defaultValue. Emits change (native click event) and blur (native event); no focus listener or emit. Template: one native button type="button" with the ripple directive (rippleDirective from ../ripple), tabindex, disabled, aria-pressed set from active, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-invalid set from invalid, @click bound to onChange and @blur; inside, a content span holding an icon span (rendered when onIcon or offIcon is set, class onIcon when active else offIcon) and a label span; no slots. active is dValue === true, so a truthy non-boolean model value renders as inactive. label is onLabel when active else offLabel, but a single space when isNotEmpty (from @ultimate/uix-utils/object) is false for either label. onChange returns before writing when disabled or readonly, otherwise writeValue(!active, event) then emits change. No readonly attribute is rendered. styleParams passes checked (active), disabled, invalid and fluid; the root renders u-toggle-button with u-toggle-button-checked, p-disabled, p-invalid and u-toggle-button-fluid. writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. The css is hand-ported rather than imported from uix-styles. A toggle-button group context is not ported (source comment). Style module registered as togglebutton.

records.name: Vue USelectButton
records.purpose: Group of toggle buttons, one per option, for single or multiple selection.
records.surface: USelectButton (Options API SFC SelectButton.vue, name "USelectButton") and createBaseSelectButton (BaseSelectButton.ts) plus selectButtonStyleModule and SelectButtonClassesParams (select-button-style.ts; not re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseEditableHolder directly (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue), not createBaseInput, so there is no pcFluid injection or inherited variant prop; because the holder is created with its empty default style module, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. Declared props: options (default empty array), optionLabel, optionValue, optionDisabled (each a string key or function, default null), multiple, allowEmpty (true), disabled, ariaLabelledby plus modelValue and defaultValue. Emits change with { originalEvent: new Event("change"), value }, a synthetic Event rather than the user's event. Template: root div role="group" with aria-labelledby, rendering one UToggleButton per option (composed from ../toggle-button/ToggleButton.vue, record vue.toggle-button) with model-value from isSelected, on-label and off-label both set to the option label, disabled when the group or the option is disabled, and update:model-value bound to onOptionSelect; no slots. The root cx call passes the constant { fluid: false }, so u-select-button-fluid is never applied, and the invalid param is never passed, so u-select-button-invalid is never applied. getOptionLabel, getOptionValue and isOptionDisabled accept a function or a string key (string keys read only from non-null objects; labels fall back to String(option) and a null key value gives an empty label). isSelected compares by strict equality; in multiple mode it also requires an array dValue. onOptionSelect returns when the group or option is disabled; in multiple mode it removes a selected value (returning early when allowEmpty is false and one value remains) or appends one; in single mode it writes null when the selected option is chosen again (returning early when allowEmpty is false) and the option value otherwise; it calls writeValue(newValue) without an event. The source comment lists dataKey equality, item slots and roving tabindex as not ported. writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. The css is hand-ported rather than imported from uix-styles. Style module registered as selectbutton.

records.name: Vue URating
records.purpose: Row of star options backed by visually hidden native radio inputs in one radio group, with pointer clearing, an invalid state, icon slots and pass-through.
records.surface: URating (Options API SFC Rating.vue, name "URating", inheritAttrs false) and createBaseRating (BaseRating.ts) plus ratingStyleModule, RatingRootClassesParams, RatingOptionClassesParams and RatingIconClassesParams (rating-style.ts; not re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseRating extends createBaseEditableHolder({componentName: "rating", styleModule}) (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue), so cx, style registration under the Aura rating key, unstyled, dt and pt come from the shared base chain; it does not shadow cx or mounted. Declared props: stars (5), readonly, disabled, invalid, name, onIcon and offIcon (class strings) and ariaLabelledby, plus modelValue and defaultValue. Emits rate ({ originalEvent, value }), focus and blur, carrying the native radio focus and blur events. Template: root div role="group" with aria-labelledby, cx root (p-readonly, p-disabled), data-p and ptmi('root'); one option div per star (cx option with active and focusVisible, data-p-active, data-p-focused, ptm('option') with the context { active, focused }) with a click handler, containing a hidden-accessible span (ptm hiddenOptionInputContainer) with an input type="radio" (value, name, checked when the value equals the star, disabled, readonly, aria-label "1 star" or "N stars", aria-invalid when invalid, ptm hiddenOptionInput) bound to @focus, @blur and @change, followed by the onicon or officon slot (scope value, class and toggleCallback) whose fallback is a span with the onIcon or offIcon class, else an aria-hidden 14 by 14 svg with the PrimeIcons star-fill or star path from rating-icons.ts (RATING_STAR_FILL_PATH and RATING_STAR_PATH); the icons carry p-invalid when invalid. When name is omitted every radio shares a generated group name, uuid('u_id_') + '_name'. Keyboard is the native radio group: there is no keydown handler. A native change only selects; when readonly or disabled blocks it, the radios' checked state is put back. A pointer click on an option selects that star, clears the value when the star is already selected, skips clicks whose target is the radio itself and moves focus to the radio. The focus ring shows only for keyboard focus, through a focusFromPointer flag. onFocus returns when readonly or disabled; onBlur always resets focusedOptionIndex and emits blur, with no readonly or disabled guard. writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. The CSS is the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/rating module. Forms registration is not provided.

records.name: Vue USlider
records.purpose: Draggable single-value or two-handle range slider with mouse, touch, click and keyboard input, an invalid state and pass-through.
records.surface: USlider (Options API SFC Slider.vue, name "USlider", inheritAttrs false) and createBaseSlider (BaseSlider.ts) plus sliderStyleModule (slider-style.ts, which also exports the SliderClassesParams interface; neither is re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseSlider extends createBaseEditableHolder({componentName: "slider", styleModule}) directly (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue), not createBaseInput, so there is no pcFluid injection or inherited variant prop; cx, style registration under the Aura slider key, unstyled, per-instance dt and pt come from the shared base chain. Declared props: min (0), max (100), orientation ("horizontal"), step (null), range (false), disabled, invalid, tabindex (0), ariaLabelledby, ariaLabel plus modelValue and defaultValue; there is no readonly prop. Emits change ({ originalEvent, value }) and slideend ({ originalEvent, value }). Template: root div with ptmi('root') and @click bound to onBarClick; single mode renders a range span and one handle span, range mode renders a range span and two handle spans (indices 0 and 1) bound to the range, handle, startHandler and endHandler pass-through sections; each handle has role="slider", tabindex bound to the tabindex prop and removed when disabled, aria-valuemin, aria-valuenow, aria-valuemax, aria-orientation, aria-label and aria-labelledby from the props, @mousedown, @touchstart.passive and @keydown; no aria-disabled. The handles and the range are placed with inset-inline-start (horizontal) or bottom (vertical); toPercent returns 0 when max is not greater than min. Pointer input is mouse and touch: beginDrag adds document mousemove and mouseup, or touchmove, touchend and touchcancel, listeners that are removed when the drag ends and in beforeUnmount; touch follows the identifier that started the drag. The pointer value is converted with Prime's relative step rule and mirrored when getComputedStyle(el).direction is rtl; a zero-size track is ignored. The style computeds test orientation === "horizontal" and otherwise use bottom and height, while the root class marks vertical only for "vertical", so any other orientation string gets the horizontal class with vertical positioning. updateValue rounds with toFixed(10) and clamps to min and max; in range mode it replaces only the active handle's entry with no ordering guard between handles. Pointer values pass through the step rule; keyboard values do not: ArrowLeft and ArrowDown subtract, ArrowRight and ArrowUp add (step or 1), PageDown and PageUp use ten times that, Home and End use min and max, each with preventDefault. onMouseDown, onTouchStart and onKeyDown return when disabled; onBarClick returns when disabled, for the click that follows a drag, or when the target has role slider, and picks the nearer handle in range mode (ties go to index 0) and then emits slideend; the end of a drag also emits slideend, and keyboard input never emits slideend. writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. The CSS is the shared @ultimate/uix-styles/slider module (ADR-082, ADR-101). Style module registered as slider.

records.name: Vue UKnob
records.purpose: Circular SVG dial that sets a numeric value by click, drag or keyboard.
records.surface: UKnob (Options API SFC Knob.vue, name "UKnob") and createBaseKnob (BaseKnob.ts) plus knobStyleModule (knob-style.ts; no params interface is exported; not re-exported from index.ts). Base factory chain: createBaseX extends createBaseEditableHolder directly (modelValue, defaultValue, update:modelValue, value-change, dValue, writeValue), not createBaseInput, so there is no pcFluid injection or inherited variant prop; because the holder is created with its empty default style module, the factory shadows cx() and mounted() locally over its own style module. Declared props: size (a Number, 100), readonly, step (1), min (0), max (100), strokeWidth (14), showValue (true), valueTemplate ("{value}"), disabled, valueColor, rangeColor, textColor (default hex colours), ariaLabelledby, ariaLabel plus modelValue and defaultValue. Emits change with the bare clamped number, not an event object. Template: root div containing one svg (viewBox 0 0 100 100, role="slider", width and height from size, tabindex -1 when readonly or disabled else 0, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow, aria-labelledby, aria-label, @click, @mousedown, @keydown), a range path, a value path and an optional text element showing valueToDisplay; no slots, no aria-disabled or aria-readonly. currentValue is dValue when it is a number else min. valueToDisplay replaces the first "{value}" in valueTemplate with currentValue. mapRange divides by (inMax - inMin) without a guard for max equal to min. updateFromAngle maps angles above -PI/3, and angles below the start angle after adding 2*PI, to a value, rounds it to a multiple of step from min, then updateModelValue clamps it and calls writeValue(clamped) without an event; angles in neither range return without change, and step is not guarded against 0. onClick and onMouseDown return when disabled or readonly and map offsets to an angle via atan2 from the centre (size / 2); onClick reads event.offsetX and event.offsetY; onMouseDown adds document mousemove and mouseup listeners removed only on mouseup. onKeyDown switches on event.code: ArrowRight and ArrowUp add step, ArrowLeft and ArrowDown subtract step, Home and End set min and max, PageUp and PageDown add or subtract a fixed 10 (not a multiple of step). The root class is the constant u-knob u-component. writeValue sets dValue and emits update:modelValue only when the component is controlled (modelValue passed, or neither modelValue nor defaultValue passed); value-change is always emitted. The css is hand-ported rather than imported from uix-styles; a comment in knob-style.ts cites @primeuix/styles 2.0.3 structural CSS and packages/themes/test/utils/g3a-port.mjs. Style module registered as knob.
